name: improvement_orchestrator
description: A/B replay orchestrator: runs a set of tasks against two agent revisions and returns a statistical comparison report.

unmappedExclusions.*: home excluded_tools is empty — the deny list is a pure dsh design decision from home capabilities: no NetworkAccess (web_search/web_fetch denied; the replay runner, not this persona, would reach the network) and no AgentSpawn/AgentMessage (subagent/subagent_fork/send_message/interrupt_agent denied). Home grants WriteAccess self.* — kept as write/edit since dsh cannot scope write paths per persona (recorded fidelity loss).
